display_name: 确定性 GPU 源域上下文缓存核验
description: 在 CUDA 确定性算法和 CUBLAS workspace 固定配置下，两次完整计算源 DURA 上下文，验证与独立缓存逐值一致并测量时间。

data.version: source cache R07 with fixed augmented epochs 21/22/23

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only technical cache equality and timing, no target inference or identity accuracy

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA source provenance verified by frozen_dura
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Frozen DURA v1.0 and fixed source fit seed 2026110611

expected_artifacts: source_context.pt: source-only reusable tensors; private and not committed
result.json: timings and exact source tensor equality

metric_names: source preparation and cache I/O seconds

rows.method: Fixed DURA source context computed twice using deterministic CUDA algorithms and compared with a deterministic-mode cache
rows.purpose: Produce matching-mode source cache and test full source tensor reproducibility
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source fit seed 2026110611 and DURA seed 2026092701; no model training.
expected_artifacts: source_context.pt: source-only reusable tensors; private and not committed
result.json: timings and exact source tensor equality

notes: Deterministic cache has distinct input contract and cannot be consumed by nondeterministic training.
No target IQ, labels, F weights/outputs or V.
CUDA deterministic mode and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 are set before CUDA initialization; unsupported kernels fail visibly.
Full source tensor equality does not establish equality of final trained weights or target predictions.
